strings.app.title: AI Subtitle Studio
strings.about.title: About AI Subtitle Studio
strings.about.text:
AI Subtitle Studio {version}
Local, free, multilingual subtitle production.
You are responsible for having the rights to any content you process.

Author: Ali Hubail (@hh2hz)
Official source: https://github.com/hh2hz/ai-subtitle-studio
strings.input.placeholder: Paste a video URL (YouTube, Vimeo, …) or choose a local video file
strings.quality.tip: Download quality for this link; the list shows the heights this link offers right now.
strings.quality.local_tip: A local file is used as it is.
strings.quality.low_offered: This link only offers {height}p right now. Higher qualities appeared without browser cookies - check Settings, Download access, or add a file you downloaded yourself.
strings.quality.not_offered: {height}p is not offered for this link (best: {best}p); the best available will be used instead.
strings.mode.fast.tooltip: Available subtitle sources, one ASR pass, minimal context, standard QA.
strings.mode.balanced.tooltip: Multiple sources, independent ASR, selective re-transcription, translation verification and full QA.
strings.mode.maximum_accuracy.tooltip: Strongest suitable ASR model, stricter thresholds and deeper verification. Slowest.
strings.status.pipeline_unavailable: The processing pipeline is not implemented yet (planned for milestone M1).
strings.error.input_required: Enter a YouTube URL or choose a video file.
strings.error.same_language: Source and target languages must differ.
strings.status.cancelling: Cancelling… finished work is kept and the job can be resumed.
strings.status.cancelled: Cancelled. Start the same file again to resume.
strings.error.url_not_supported_yet: YouTube URLs are not supported yet (planned for milestone M2). Choose a local file.
strings.error.pipeline_failed: Processing failed. See the technical details and the log.
strings.error.provider_auth: The provider refused the request (check the API key in Settings).
strings.error.provider_network: The provider could not be reached (network error).
strings.error.asr_unavailable: No speech recognition model could be loaded.
strings.error.mt_unavailable: No translation model could be loaded.
strings.error.no_speech: No speech was detected in this file.
strings.error.no_audio: The file has no usable audio: {path}
strings.error.media_open: The file cannot be opened as media: {path}
strings.error.url_unsupported: This URL is not supported. Use a single video link.
strings.error.video_unavailable: The video is unavailable (private, removed or region-blocked).
strings.error.rate_limited: The site is limiting requests (HTTP 429). Wait a while and try again.
strings.error.youtube_bot_check: YouTube asked to confirm you are not a bot. Under Settings, choose "Download access" and use the browser you are signed in with — or add a file you downloaded yourself.
strings.error.login_required: This site needs a signed-in session. Under Settings, choose "Download access" and use the browser you are signed in with — or add a file you downloaded yourself.
strings.error.po_token: The site refused the video stream. Update yt-dlp, or under Settings use the browser you are signed in with.
strings.error.geo_blocked: This video is not available in your country. A different network or a proxy may help.
strings.error.age_restricted: This video is age-restricted and needs a signed-in session. Under Settings, use the browser you are signed in with.
strings.error.download_failed: Download failed. Updating yt-dlp often helps: pip install -U "yt-dlp[default]"
strings.error.download_forbidden: The site refused the video data (HTTP 403). This is usually temporary and the app retries it; if it keeps failing, choose the browser you are signed in with under Settings, Download access.
strings.status.no_js_runtime: No JavaScript runtime (Deno) found; YouTube downloads may be incomplete. Install it with: winget install DenoLand.Deno
strings.series.keep_tip: Save the name and its poster, and offer them again next time you start the app.
strings.series.kept: Kept “{name}”. It will be offered again next time.
strings.label.saved_series_note: Removing a series keeps it in the job history but drops it from the suggestions.
strings.label.fetch_platform_subs: Fetch subtitles from the video page (YouTube)
strings.dialog.providers_note: Keys are optional and free from the providers' websites. They are stored unencrypted in the local database.
strings.status.refine_summary: AI translation: {refined}/{total} lines refined; {suggestions} reviewer suggestions listed in ReviewRequired.txt ({providers}).
strings.status.ai_tokens: AI usage: {total} tokens ({inp} input + {out} output) in {requests} requests.
strings.label.llm_refine: Improve with cloud AI models (needs internet and API keys)
strings.label.llm_correct_only: Cloud AI only corrects the local translation (fewer tokens, lower quality)
strings.label.llm_review: Double-check risky lines with a second AI model (recommended)
strings.status.no_api_keys: No API keys found: the basic translation was used. Put your keys in api_keys.local.json.
strings.review.title: Review — {name}
strings.review.no_video: Video preview is not available for this folder.
strings.review.retranslated: New AI translation from {engine}; edit if needed, then approve.
strings.review.unsaved: There are unsaved changes. Save the subtitle now?
strings.review.retranscribe_empty: No speech found in this span; the line was left unchanged.
strings.review.timeline_tip: Timeline: click to seek or select cue
strings.error.output_missing: The output folder does not exist yet: {path}
strings.error.open_folder_failed: The folder could not be opened: {path} - Windows refused it because this program runs in a restricted environment (for example started from a sandboxed terminal or tool). Start it by double-clicking launch.bat or the Start-menu shortcut. The path was copied to the clipboard.
strings.deps.title: Starting AI Subtitle Studio
strings.flag.weak_ai_model: translated by a weaker AI model (stronger models were busy)
strings.flag.name_mismatch: a character name is missing or differs from the original
strings.flag.ai_disagreement: the second model disagrees (both versions are kept)
strings.status.local_model_failed: The local AI model could not run, so the basic MADLAD engine was used. Details are in the log.
strings.status.burn_failed: Could not create the video with subtitles: {error}
strings.label.burn_video: After each job, also save a copy of the video with the subtitles drawn in (plays anywhere, takes a few minutes)
strings.theme.tooltip: Theme: Auto follows Windows; click to switch
strings.app.tagline: Accurate subtitles for any video, in any language
strings.gpu.offer:
An NVIDIA graphics card was found. Downloading its acceleration libraries (about 1.2 GB, once) makes speech recognition several times faster.

Download now?
strings.gpu.later: GPU acceleration can be downloaded later from Settings.
strings.gpu.started: Downloading the GPU libraries in the background; you can keep working.
strings.gpu.done: GPU libraries installed. The next job uses the graphics card.
strings.gpu.failed: GPU libraries could not be downloaded: {error}
strings.label.diarization: Detect who is speaking (runs on the CPU)
strings.label.snap_to_shots: Snap subtitle times to scene changes (slower)
strings.tip.snap_to_shots: Moves a subtitle start or end that is within a quarter of a second of a scene change onto the cut. Needs the video; adds a few minutes per episode. Frame snapping is always on.
strings.tip.diarization: Finds the speakers after transcription so the translation can use gender and who is addressed. It runs on the CPU and takes a few minutes per episode.
strings.status.enhancing_audio: Cleaning the audio (removing music and noise)…
strings.error.burn_no_files: No video or subtitle file was found in the episode folder.
strings.error.no_ffmpeg: FFmpeg was not found; it is needed to create a video with subtitles.
strings.error.no_libass: This FFmpeg build cannot draw subtitles (libass is missing).
strings.error.burn_failed: FFmpeg could not create the video (details in the log).
strings.label.cookies_source: Cookies for sites that require a login:
strings.label.cookies_browser: Browser (you must be signed in there):
strings.label.force_ipv4: Force IPv4 (some networks are refused over IPv6)
strings.access.note: yt-dlp reads the cookies itself; this app never copies, stores or logs them. Needed only when a site asks you to sign in. Without cookies, downloading the file yourself and opening it here always works.
strings.queue.title: Batch Queue
strings.history.title: Job History
strings.deps.failed: A problem was found with the libraries.
strings.deps.error_body: The libraries could not be checked or repaired automatically. The app may not work correctly:
strings.label.keep_job_cache: Keep the working files after an episode is finished (for debugging)
strings.tip.keep_job_cache: Off by default: when an episode finishes, its cache is deleted so that processing it again starts from scratch. Everything you need (subtitles, audio, master transcript, log) stays in the episode's output folder. Turn this on only to inspect the stages. A failed or cancelled episode always keeps its cache so it can be resumed.
strings.keys.title: API keys
strings.keys.intro_first: Welcome! Cloud AI models improve the translation. They are free, optional and need an API key from each provider. Paste the keys you have; one key is enough and more keys mean fewer interruptions. Leave a provider empty to skip it - you can add it later in Settings -> API keys.
strings.keys.intro: Paste the key of each provider you use. A provider left empty is skipped. Keys are saved on this computer only, never in the settings database and never in the log.
strings.keys.account_id: Account ID (needed with the Cloudflare key)
strings.keys.open_tip: Add, change or remove the API keys of the cloud AI providers.
strings.keys.need_account: The {provider} key needs the Account ID too.
strings.keys.save_failed: The keys could not be saved to {path}: {error}
strings.label.update_check: Check for a newer version when the program starts
strings.tip.update_check: Contacts github.com once at start to see whether a newer release exists. No personal data is sent. Nothing is installed without your confirmation.
strings.update.title: Update available
strings.update.keep: Your settings, API keys and history are kept. The program closes, installs the update and starts again.
strings.update.manual: A newer version is available. Open the download page to get it.
strings.update.download_failed: The update could not be downloaded: {error}
strings.update.busy: A job is running. Finish or cancel it, then update.
strings.review.preview_preparing: This video format cannot be played here. Preparing a compatible preview copy...
strings.review.preview_failed: The video cannot be played here and a preview copy could not be made. You can still review and edit the subtitles.
strings.error.preview_failed: The preview copy could not be created.
strings.label.parallel_jobs: Videos in progress at the same time
strings.tip.parallel_jobs: Queue videos are processed like a production line: while one is on the graphics card, the next one downloads, another has its speakers detected and two more are translated by the AI. Heavy work still runs one video at a time on the graphics card and one at a time on the processor. 1 = one video after the other.
strings.queue.playlist_loading: Reading the playlist… the window stays usable.
